ItemID: 1; Title: Machine Screws, 100 PCS Phillips Pan Head Electricians Screw Kit #6-32#8-32 Thread 304 Stainless Steel Screws for Electrical Wall Plate Switch, Receptacles Mounting Screws with Storage Case; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for repair work, but I would pass this time because my recent purchases already include several machine-screw assortments.
ItemID: 2; Title: TPOIMNS PLA Filament 1.75mm, Navy Blue PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1kg Spool (2.2lbs), Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03mm, Used by Most FDM 3D Printer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current projects center on mechanical fastening and fabrication; I have no established need for printer filament.
ItemID: 3; Title: M5-0.8 x 10mm (60 PCS) Button Head Socket Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, ISO7380; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in metric hardware, but I would need a specific use for this length before buying a dedicated pack.
ItemID: 4; Title: LIONMAX #8 x 1-5/8" Exterior Wood Screws, 800 PCS Star Drive Deck Screws, Tan Coated for Outdoor Use, Coarse Threads, No Stripping, Anti-Rust, T-25 Drive Bit Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An 800-piece exterior screw pack feels excessive without an active outdoor woodworking project.
ItemID: 5; Title: Self Tapping Screws Assortment Fasteners Set, 650pcs 304 Stainless Steel M3/M4/M5/M6 Sheet Metal Screws Kit with Storage Box,Phillips Drive Wood Screw Assortment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The range of sizes would complement my rivets and threaded fasteners for varied fabrication and repair jobs, though it overlaps my earlier screw kit.
ItemID: 6; Title: Breezliy 2100 PCS Brad Nails 7 Sizes multi-Length Galvanized Straight Finishing Nail,Each specification has an independent sponge anti-collision packaging; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent work points more toward bolts, rivets and inserts than finish carpentry, so I would skip this large nail assortment.
ItemID: 7; Title: JIENUO Cordless Shop Vac Wet and Dry, with 20V 4.0Ah Battery and Charger, 2.5 Gallon Shop Wet Dry Vacuum Cleaner with Blower Function, Portable Commercial Vac for Car, Home and Garage; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A portable vacuum would be useful for cleaning debris after drilling and fabrication, and the included battery and charger make it appealing.
ItemID: 8; Title: Joywayus Brass 1/2"NPS Female 4-Way Pipe Fitting Adapter Tube Coupler Connector Water Gas Oil (Pack of 2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is a specialized fitting, and nothing in my recent activity gives me a current need for that connection.
ItemID: 9; Title: #8 x 5/8" Wafer Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Mushroom Head Phillips Drive Self Tapping Screws, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Short self-drilling screws look useful for sheet-metal fastening alongside my rivet tools; I would try a pack for suitable jobs.
ItemID: 10; Title: M6-1.0 x 30mm (20 Pcs) Socket Head Cap Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, DIN912; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: They fit my interest in metric assembly hardware, but I would check my existing assortment and required length before ordering more.
